When complete guard expression is false, no state components are updated in this bounded model.

shift_amount_rule.statement: Shift amount is clamped when it exceeds register width N; bounded form uses clamp by width 32 for shr.b32 pending explicit N expansion.

fill_behavior.statement: Right shift fill is sign-bit when signed type forms are used, otherwise zero-fill.
